client_brief:
Nimbadesk launch collateral using the current product build

We need the sell sheets, pitch deck and launch social to look like one product. Each sell sheet, the deck's opening page and each launch post carry the Nimbadesk mark from nimbadesk_logo_v4.png. There are eleven product captures in the pack, but the first job is to establish which belong to the current build and how they should be presented consistently.

Scope
1. B2B product sell sheet: 4 named exports. The stated metric preserves its qualification: its mono measurement line gives the window the figure covers, as our supplied files state it. The UI is a faithful supplied capture from the current build, showing the feature its sheet's copy block describes. Each sheet carries one approved sell-sheet block from nimbadesk_copy.txt, word for word, in the order given there: Median first response time with Unified Queue, Tickets resolved per agent with SLA & Routing, Customer satisfaction (CSAT) with Reporting for Directors.
2. Product pitch deck: 1 named export. The narrative explains the customer problem before the offer. The claims follow approved copy.
3. Product launch post: 3 named exports. The product name is clear, and each post shows what it is named for: Workflow our queue and routing, Reporting our director reporting, each in a current-build capture, and Team the people behind Nimbadesk, from the supplied booth headshots. The request-demo action is visible: our approved 20-minute walkthrough line from nimbadesk_copy.txt, word for word.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Wherever a metric appears, in the deck or a post, it carries the same window as on its sell sheet. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: B2B help desk software sold per seat to IT and operations leads at fifty to five hundred person firms.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2024, Denver, Colorado, an eleven person team fourteen months into private beta.
brand_identity.about: Nimbadesk is help desk software for the internal IT and operations teams that keep mid sized companies running. We replace the tangle of shared inboxes and half configured legacy tools with one queue, clear ownership and reporting a director can actually read. We sell to the person who has to defend the line item, so everything we show is real: real screens, real numbers, real periods.
brand_identity.audience: IT and operations leads aged thirty to fifty at fifty to five hundred person firms who sign annual contracts and route the invoice past a finance director. They evaluate carefully, compare tiers before reading copy, and distrust hype.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Per seat tiers at 29, 79 and 249 dollars, with enterprise annual near 18,000. Mid market: above the free consumer tools, well below the enterprise suites, priced to be defended rather than impulse bought.

palette.name: Nimbus Ink
palette.usage: Headlines, body text and the product name on Paper or Mist, as the name and company lines on nimbadesk_badge_2026.pdf, and published figures unless they are set in Signal Blue; may also be a solid panel carrying Paper type, as the navigation rail in nimbadesk_ui_03.png carries the Nimbadesk name in white.

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.usage: Accent bands, rules, buttons and published figures: the edge band and the rule under the company line on nimbadesk_badge_2026.pdf, a button fill with a Paper label, as the New ticket button in nimbadesk_ui_01.png, and a figure on Paper or Mist, as the KPI figures 1,245, 3.5 hrs, 982 and 4.7/5 on white cards in nimbadesk_ui_03.png. Never a ground, a headline or body text.

palette.name: Slate
palette.usage: Footnotes, which the type system sets in Slate, and secondary lines such as roles and captions, as the role line on nimbadesk_badge_2026.pdf; the mono measurement line may be Slate or Nimbus Ink. Never a ground, a panel, a figure or a headline.

palette.name: Mist
palette.usage: A secondary ground or panel, such as the backing behind a capture or a headshot, as the photo-well backing on nimbadesk_badge_2026.pdf. Never type.

palette.name: Paper
palette.usage: The main ground, as on nimbadesk_badge_2026.pdf, and every line of type or button label set on Nimbus Ink or Signal Blue.

palette.name: Verify Green
palette.usage: Small status marks only, such as a tick, as Verify Green marks resolved tickets in nimbadesk_ui_10.png and the satisfaction trend in nimbadesk_ui_09.png. Never a ground, a panel, a figure, a headline or body text.

brand_identity.typography: Nimbadesk builds the page around the figure. Zilla Slab Bold sets the published number at 64 pt on 68 pt, tracking minus 8 units, tabular figures, and its measurement window sits flush left directly beneath it in IBM Plex Mono Medium at 9 pt on 12 pt tracked plus 5 units, so a figure never stands alone. Sell sheet headlines take the same slab at 28 pt on 32 pt, tracking minus 5 units, and launch headlines run 72 px on 78 px. Inter Regular sets body at 10 pt on 14.5 pt, tracking 0, measure held to 65 characters, or 18 px on 28 px on screen, and footnotes at 7.5 pt on 11 pt in Slate.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, specific, understated. Numbers carry the argument and every claim states its period. Example line the brand would write: "Thirty one teams moved their queue to Nimbadesk this year. Here is what changed, and over what window."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No source files exist. The mark was generated by our first designer with an AI tool and delivered only as a flat picture, which is the single copy anywhere. There is no vector, no guideline document and no defined weight. Screenshots were captured ad hoc across the year at whatever scale the display was set to.
brand_identity.values: Evidence over theatre, and software a finance director would sign off without flinching.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every published number is a heavy slab figure with its measurement period set in mono directly beneath it, flush left, so a figure never appears on its own.

scale.note: The published figure. Its measurement window sets in IBM Plex Mono Medium at 9 pt flush left directly beneath, per step 04, and no figure is ever published without it.
Sell sheet headline. Launch headlines take the same face at 72 px on 78 px.

scale.sample: One queue, clear ownership, and reporting a director can actually read.
scale.note: 18 px on 28 px for the launch post and the deck.
The measurement window, flush left beneath its figure. Footnotes are the one item that stays in text face: Inter Regular at 7.5 pt on 11 pt in Slate.

type_system.signature_move: Every published number is a Zilla Slab Bold figure at 64 pt with its measurement window in IBM Plex Mono Medium at 9 pt flush left directly beneath it, so a figure never stands on its own.
rules: Never publish a figure without its mono measurement line beneath it.
The measurement window is always flush left under the figure, never centred and never set beside it.
Only real screens, real numbers and real periods; nothing illustrative or invented.
Footnotes stay 7.5 pt Inter Regular in Slate.
Nothing in the collateral reads as hype; the numbers carry the argument.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds are Paper, with Mist as a secondary ground or panel and Nimbus Ink as an optional solid panel. On Paper or Mist, headlines, body text and the product name are Nimbus Ink, as the name on nimbadesk_badge_2026.pdf; published figures are Nimbus Ink or Signal Blue, as nimbadesk_ui_03.png sets its KPI figures in Signal Blue on white cards; roles, captions and the mono measurement line are Nimbus Ink or Slate, as the role line on the badge; footnotes are Slate. On Nimbus Ink or Signal Blue, all type is Paper. Signal Blue is only for bands, rules, buttons and figures, and Verify Green only for small status marks; together they cover no more than 10% of the designed, non-photographic area (about 5% on the badge), neither is ever a ground or the colour of a headline or body text, and Verify Green is never a figure.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, as every fill on nimbadesk_badge_2026.pdf is. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over an interface capture or a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons: not the lighter sky blue of the gradient inside nimbadesk_logo_v4.png, and not the amber or red of the status badges inside the captures. The Nimbadesk mark keeps its own colours, and none of them is borrowed for the design.
palette_rules.photography: Interface captures and booth headshots keep their own colour and content and are never recoloured toward the palette. The Verify Green, amber and red status colours inside the captures belong to the real screens: they are not counted against the palette and not changed. Faces keep the skin tones of their own frames, and the warm beige and pale grey office walls behind the headshots are not tinted toward Mist or Signal Blue.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve approved copy, dimensions, hierarchy, and reproduction requirements; do not imply a data merge or editable system that is outside the scoped deliverables.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
